info.name: Flock Safety API Platform (v3) Alerts Vehicle Images API

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The ID of the device that this image was captured by.

items.docs: Uploads images of a vehicle that will be ingested and processed. The total size of the main vehicle image and all of the context images must not exceed 9 MB. File size is calculated in binary mb (MB), where 1 MB is 1048576 bytes.
